Randstad is currently working with an exciting client to find a SAP Functional Analyst (EHS - Environment Health and Safety). This is an initial contract until June 2027 with potential of extension, based in Brisbane CBD with WFH flexibility. We are seeking an experienced SAP Functional Analyst specialising in Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) to lead solution design, configuration, and integration activities for a major Modern ERP initiative. This is a brilliant opportunity to apply your technical expertise to enhance operational efficiency and future-proof critical systems.   Role: SAP Functional Analyst (EHS - Environment Health and Safety)   Client: Public Sector Client   Contract Length: Until June 2027 with potential of extension   Location: Brisbane CBD with WFH flexibility   Rates: Open Market Rates   
  Key Duties:  
 
 
 Lead the solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment of SAP Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) modules. 
 
 
 Facilitate workshops, manage business and functional requirements, and perform fit-to-standard assessments and gap analyses. 
 
 
 Support and validate SAP EHS integrations with key enterprise modules, such as Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and HR. 
 
 
 Govern external service provider deliverables, ensuring alignment with program standards, policies, and business expectations. 
 
 
 Coordinate solution assurance, defect management, data migration, and procurement requirement activities across project lifecycles. 
 
 
  The ideal candidate will possess:  
 
 
 Demonstrated experience with at least one full SAP S/4HANA Greenfield implementation. 
 
 
 Deep functional expertise in SAP Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) modules and SAP Fiori applications. 
 
 
 Proven track record of integrating SAP EHS with other core modules like Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and HR. 
 
 
 Experience with project management tools and tracking systems such as Jira, MS Project, or SAP CALM. 
 
 
 Strong stakeholder engagement, analytical, and communication skills to navigate complex cross-functional environments. 
 
 
   Interested? Apply Now!  
 If you are a SAP Functional Analyst with experience in SAP Environment, Health, and Safety (EHS) module implementation, we want to hear from you. Click "Apply Now". 
   Randstad contractor benefits:  
 
 
 Access to a Udemy license for ongoing learning and continuous professional development 
 
 
 Access to exclusive discounts across various platforms 
 
 
 Discounts on private health funds 
 
 
 3 payruns a week. 
 
 

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
Job Description: 
Required a results-driven Senior Data Engineer with experience in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise-scale data engineering solutions across data warehousing, big data, and cloud platforms.

Key Responsibilities & Leadership -
•	Design and implement enterprise-scale data architectures, including Data Warehouses and Data Lakes.
•	Build and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for analytics, reporting, and operational workloads.
•	Lead end-to-end data migration and modernisation programs from legacy systems to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, and AWS platforms using Agile methodology.
•	Define and execute migration strategies, including data analysis, mapping, transformation, integration, validation, reconciliation, and production deployment.
•	Design and optimise data models, SQL queries, and Spark workloads to improve performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
•	Develop automation solutions to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency.
•	Ensure data quality, consistency, governance, and compliance across enterprise data platforms.
•	Perform data profiling, validation, and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and reliability of data assets.
•	Lead technical design reviews, architecture discussions, and code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices and standards.
•	Manage full project lifecycle delivery, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
•	Collaborate with architects, business analysts, product owners, and clients to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
